paragraphs: The stock price of Fermi Inc. is 6.31, with a 4.64% change versus the prior close and a -23.14% change over a window of 22 sessions.

Recent news includes Cetera Investment Advisers raising its stock position in Fermi Inc. by 3,262.3% during the 1st quarter, and the company expecting to sign binding agreements with tenants over the next year. Other news includes a $375M convertible note deal and the company's cofounder Toby Neugebauer commenting on market support.

There have been various SEC filings, including the appointment of new officers, the resignation of director Miles Everson, and the issuance of $431.25 million in aggregate principal amount of 5.00% convertible senior notes due 2031. There has been 1 Form 4 filing and 16 proxy solicitation filings.
